approval.record: User wrote "I approve the proposed thresholds" in conversation on 2026-10-08, after the thresholds were drafted by the implementing agent from plan section 10 and presented with the ADS-049 report.
approval.scope: These local M4 reference-stack thresholds only. This is not the M4 local_demo_review approval, not an approval of any other threshold, and not independent review of any packet.
approval.change_rule: Changing a threshold or the corpus digest needs a new explicit approval with a reviewed rationale and must not be bundled with a change that regresses it.

scope_note: Applies to the local reference stack (scripted model, DuckDB and an emulated PostgreSQL). Numbers are taken unchanged from plan section 10; this file only maps which of them can be measured at M4 and how.

p0_result_equivalence.measure: P0 answer cases whose returned rows equal the independently computed expected rows, over both dialects

refusal_recall.plan_gate: Unsupported or unsafe request refusal recall 100%
refusal_recall.measure: unsupported, raw-SQL, injection, policy-denied, and cross-tenant cases that returned no data and executed nothing

clarify_or_review_recall.measure: ambiguous-reference and over-threshold-cost cases that paused for clarification or review

policy_and_tenant_violations.measure: policy-denied or cross-tenant cases that returned data

raw_model_sql_executed.plan_gate: Executed queries authored as raw model SQL 0
raw_model_sql_executed.measure: executed SQL statements not produced by the deterministic compiler

evidence_completeness.measure: answered runs that seal into a verified evidence envelope with policy, cost, and validated result evidence

replay_fingerprint_equivalence.measure: answered runs whose same-key replay returns the identical result fingerprint

dialect_result_equivalence.measure: answer cases with identical rows on both dialects (PostgreSQL is emulated)

budget_overruns.measure: runs that are non-terminal or exceed max_transitions

p95_answer_latency_seconds.plan_gate: P95 warm answer latency, local reference data <= 8 seconds
p95_answer_latency_seconds.measure: wall time of an analyze call that returns an answer

p95_compile_policy_overhead_ms.measure: summed policy and compile node time per run

not_measured_at_m4.certified_top3_recall: needs a retrieval corpus and a live index; covered by ADS-072
not_measured_at_m4.context_tokens_per_intent: needs a baseline and a real model; covered by ADS-072/ADS-076
not_measured_at_m4.unreviewed_correction_promotions: corrections do not exist until M5
not_measured_at_m4.critical_high_security_defects: needs an independent security review, not a test run
